scope: 1.0 mL of lysis buffer consisting of 12.5 mM Tris pH 8.0 (Fisher Scientific), 0.5 mM EDTA (EMD Inc.), 7.5 M urea (Sigma-Aldrich), and 1X protease inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich) was added to the tissue samples and homogenised using a PRO-250 (ProScientific) Homogeniser probe on ice, followed by sonication using a Branson probe sonicator (Fisher Scientific).
